51577910.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CM5 chip immobilized recombinant human PD-L1 assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Binding affinity: Referring to the Biacore T200 operating instructions, the pH scouting for the recombinant hPD-L1 protein immobilization was performed with 10 mM acetate buffer at pH 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, and 5.5 to determine the optimal coupling conditions at pH 5.5, and then approximately 7000 response units (RU) of recombinant hPD-L1 were cured on CM5 chips using amine coupling by a standard amine coupling procedure. The compounds to be tested were prepared use running buffer (10 mM HEPES supplemented with 5 % DMSO) to 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.0625, 0.03125, 0.015625, 0.0078125 μM. Biacore T200 flow rate was set to 30 μL/min. The compounds to be measured were allowed to pass through the hPD-L1 curing channel and the blank reference channel and the signal was collected. Steady-state KD values were calculated using Biacore T200 evaluation software.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Fig. 3. The SPR profiles of 17 (A), 18 (B), 19 (C), 22 (D), and BMS-1 (E) at different concentrations with hPD-L1.

Compounds Ka (M−1 s−1) Kdis (s−1) KD (nM) 17 1.161 × 105 1.647 × 10−2 141.860 18 4.370 × 105 1.156 × 10−2 26.453 19 5.306 × 105 9.306 × 10−3 17.538 22 7.902 × 105 4.005 × 10−3 5.068 BMS-1 1.167 × 105 1.637 × 10−2 140.274 a Data are generated from eight different concentrations. Ka, association constant; Kdis, dissociation constant; KD = Kdis/Ka (see Table 4).
